\section[der Garten]{der Garten — a garden}

\label{lesson:GE-C77-garten}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the German for a wall, then the German for a roof.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: der Garten}
\textbf{der Garten} — \textquotedblleft{}a garden\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{Garten} $\leftarrow$ Old High German \emph{garto} $\leftarrow$ Proto-Germanic \emph{*gardô}, \textquotedblleft{}enclosed yard\textquotedblright{} — inherited, the same word as English \emph{yard}. (EtymDB 2.1)
\end{cousinweb}

\end{grammarlens}

\end{itemize}
